rachel: Heads-up PR #523 added a Troubleshooting entry for rate/timeout behavior. Reviewers say the SDK examples conflate timeouts with 429s and lack deterministic trimming + Retry-After handling. Can someone propose a concise, testable snippet?
omar: I can do Python + JS. Key points: bounded retries, honor Retry-After or X-RateLimit-Reset, deterministic trimming (keep system block), then fallback to a smaller model or a cached response. Keep examples <=10 lines.
kevin: +1. Also call out when to abort (timeouts) vs when to backoff (429).
omar: Python draft:
```python
# bounded retries -> trim -> fallback
for i in range(2):
  r = client.generate(model='large', prompt=prompt, timeout=5)
  if r.status == 200:
    return r.text
  if r.status == 429:
    time.sleep((2**i) * 0.3)
# deterministic trim: preserve system/instruction block
trimmed = '\n'.join(prompt.split('\n')[-3:])
return client.generate(model='small', prompt=trimmed).text
```
ci-bot: CI: docs-lint failed on PR 523 (code-fence style). https://ci.redwood.ai/523
rachel: This is great. Add a one-liner: 'Test trimming with eval prompts; separate system/instructions from history.' Omar, can you push a formatting fix and a unit test that verifies the system line is preserved when trimming?
omar: Pushed formatting fix + tiny unit test to assert system prompt retention.
kevin: I'll loop in eng-runtime to confirm fallback routing to smaller models won't violate policy rules.
ci-bot: PR 523 lint passed.
rachel: Thanks all — will merge after eng-runtime gives thumbs-up.
